farCommon: Use case: game-asset. A modular far-background texture for our 2D side-scrolling metroidvania. Reference 1 establishes our actual game's coarse tactile matte paper/graphite painterly rendering. Reference 2 shows current crayon region. Same broad restrained paper fibers, soft irregular silhouettes and hand-painted large material planes, NOT photographic, no tiny sharp hatching, no 3D glossy plastic. This is the distant BACK WALL behind gameplay: dark, low contrast, no floor, ceiling, platforms, UI, creatures, letters or light source. Fill canvas with a continuous material field, seamlessly tileable horizontally and vertically. Very large irregular forms cross edges naturally; no central focal symbol and no obvious repeating per-tile motif. Large enough to span many gameplay tiles. Desired square 1536x1536.

zones.title: 노을 크레파스 굴
zones.prompt: Burnt terracotta and muted warm umber layered crayon-wax strata pressed into thick handmade paper. Huge sloping hills of wax, folded color ribbons half-buried in paper. Subtle distant dusk warmth in recesses. Keep shadow values predominantly dark brown/charcoal, softened muted orange planes.

zones.title: 밀랍 공방
zones.prompt: Sooty ochre and olive-brown wax workshop cavern wall. Thick cooled wax flows over pressed paper strata, broad smooth drips interrupted by coarse paper fibers, hints of old charcoal stains. No actual machines in this far layer. Dark smoky golden ochre highlights with near-black warm gray recesses.

zones.title: 색칠 지하 협곡
zones.prompt: Deep desaturated indigo-blue and slate-violet pigment canyon back wall, broad horizontal layers of thick crayon and pressed paper with a few deep vertical eroded gaps. Muted cool pigment ridges, very restrained teal seams, charcoal recesses. Large layered material, no sharp crystal patterns.

zones.title: 기사의 탑
zones.prompt: Faded burgundy, dusty mauve and charcoal rose wax-coated paper masonry in a forgotten knight tower. Broad softly broken flattened architectural layers and erased heraldic traces, NO repeated emblem, no actual windows in this far layer. Restrained dark red-violet values; aged paper texture.

midCommon: Use case: game-asset. Draw FOUR distinct modular mid-background architectural cutouts in an EXACT equal 2 columns x 2 rows grid, isolated on real transparent alpha. No floor tiles, no characters, no labels or borders. Entire object contained in each square cell with 7% clear margins. Same orthographic SIDE-SCROLLER view in all four cells. Match references' coarse hand-painted paper/wax textures and rounded broad irregular material planes, no photorealism, no glossy metal, no thin hatching. Structures must feel ancient, heavy, dark, background contrast below gameplay. Large asymmetric silhouettes with generous empty holes, no repeated central pattern. Intended to be recomposed irregularly for differently sized rooms. Desired2048x2048.

midPrompts.prompt: Zone: sunset crayon caves, burnt terracotta, dark warm umber with dusty pale wax edges. Top-left: huge broken crayon-and-layered-paper arch tilted left. Top-right: tall crooked melted crayon columns held by torn paper straps. Bottom-left: low asymmetrical pile of snapped crayon slabs and open wax jar fragments. Bottom-right: a ruined paper windmill ventilation frame with only three uneven broad vanes. Not cute toys.

Zone: abandoned wax workshop, smoky ochre, olive-brown, soot black and parchment. Top-left: a large cold crucible furnace arch with empty dark mouth. Top-right: crooked tall chimney and sagging thick wax pipes. Bottom-left: low old workbench with oversize scraping paddle and wax molds. Bottom-right: irregular two-level storage rack containing wax jars, some empty shelves and thick drips. No active bright flame.

Zone: pigment canyon, desaturated indigo, dusty blue-violet, charcoal and restrained cool teal. Top-left: huge torn paper pigment cliff arch with broad strata. Top-right: tall descending folded paper waterfall of thick blue wax with several dark gaps, no glowing water. Bottom-left: broken long crayon bridge fragments resting sideways. Bottom-right: broad asymmetric low accumulation of colored pigment slabs and erased paper layers.

Zone: broken crayon knight tower, dusty burgundy, faded rose, soot plum and old parchment edges. Top-left: large broken gothic-like folded-paper arch with a split spear-shaped apex, not a real stone cathedral. Top-right: tall buttress and crooked arrow-slit window frame coated in matte wax. Bottom-left: low scattered broken crayon lances, battered wax shields and torn paper pennants. Bottom-right: an open empty heraldic niche with a single frayed hanging banner and no emblem repetition.

monsterCommon: Use case: identity-preserve game animation sprite sheet. Draw exactly TWENTY FOUR complete independent whole-character frames in an EXACT uniform 4 columns x 6 rows grid, real transparent alpha, no labels, no cell borders, no floor line, no text. Desired1536x2304, equal square cells. The SAME creature design, proportions, size, side view facing RIGHT and fixed camera in every cell. Body size about62% of cell width/height with generous clear margins. Grounded feet baseline y84% in each cell; flying creatures centered at52%, no translation across cells. Match the game's broad matte paper/wax fibers, thick tactile painted surfaces, soft edges and low-saturation colored wax from reference, detailed enough at game scale, no pixel art, no glossy 3D, no thin noisy hatching. Do not draw the reference player or background. Frames 1-8 (first two rows): MOVE, coherent alternating whole-body walking/fluttering loop that ends matching frame1. Frames9-16 (middle two rows): ATTACK: frames9-12 clear growing anticipation, frame13 decisive strike/release,14 followthrough,15-16 recovery. Frames17-24 (last two rows): DEATH: body buckles, breaks into large wax-paper scraps, then dissipates; final frame only a few faint scraps. No red blood, no light explosion. Never use joint rigs or detached limbs. No stretched wormlike anatomy. Keep the same character scale across all24 frames including death.

monsters.name: 크레용 병정
monsters.appearance: Small heavy crayon soldier with blunt rounded orange wax helmet, short thick legs and one dark crayon-tipped short spear, worn paper collar
monsters.attack: 창을 당기고 2회 찌름. 두 타 사이 0.28초, 두 번째까지 방향 고정
monsters.response: 뒤로 거리를 벌리거나 등 뒤로 이동해 두 번째 뒤 공격
monsters.parry: 습득 후 두 타 모두 패링하면 1.2초 그로기; 한 번만 성공해도 해당 타격 방어
monsters.caution: 0.46초 공격 구간은 두 타와 사이 텀 포함; 첫 소개에 다른 원거리 금지

monsters.name: 밀랍 투척꾼
monsters.appearance: Squat ochre wax creature with a broad ladle-like forearm and a rounded candle-pot belly carrying one large amber wax ball
monsters.attack: 팔 위 밀랍을 크게 들고 한 덩이 투척; 착탄에 둔화 웅덩이
monsters.response: 몸을 이동해 착탄 회피; 근접 중 긴 회복 공격
monsters.parry: 탄 반사로 경직과 색 막대 장치 가동. 14번 장치용 개체 별도 관리
monsters.caution: 장치용은 다리 작동 전 처치 불가 표시+재공급 보장; 일반 개체는 정상 처치

monsters.name: 색가루 박쥐
monsters.appearance: Low-saturation mauve bat with thick scalloped wax-paper wings and a small heavy crayon chip torso, two soft ear fins
monsters.attack: 가루가 모이고 목표 방향 고정 후 짧은 급강하, 낮게 복귀
monsters.response: 예고 후 옆으로 이동; 복귀 중 공격
monsters.parry: 습득 후 급강하 패링 시 바닥에 눕고 1초 노출
monsters.caution: 공통 나방보다 느린 대기·빠른 직선, 동시 배치 금지로 역할 중복 완화

monsters.name: 노을 등짐충
monsters.appearance: Broad rust-orange wax beetle carrying three rounded sunset crayon slabs on its back with small charcoal feet and pale belly
monsters.attack: 등짐을 앞으로 기울이고 비탈 따라 짧게 돌진
monsters.response: 점프로 넘기고 멈춘 뒤 배 공격
monsters.parry: 획득 후 정면 돌진 패링으로 등짐 흔들림
monsters.caution: 종이공과 다른 평지에서 소개; 비탈 아래 안전 공간 확보

monsters.name: 색띠 달팽이
monsters.appearance: Wide low snail with a rolled orange-peach crayon ribbon shell, matte layered color bands and a dark soft body
monsters.attack: 몸을 들어 뒤쪽에 짧은 밀랍 띠 하나 흘림, 1.5초 후 소멸
monsters.response: 앞쪽으로 돌아 접근하거나 띠를 점프로 넘음
monsters.parry: 바닥 띠는 패링 불가; 전방 머리 밀기만 가능
monsters.caution: 길 전체 봉쇄 금지; 달팽이 사망 즉시 띠 제거

monsters.name: 바람개비 새
monsters.appearance: Small asymmetric pinwheel bird with three broad rounded folded wax-paper wing vanes, muted terracotta and cream, tiny dark beak
monsters.attack: 날개가 한 번 접힌 뒤 수평으로 고정 경로 횡단
monsters.response: 출발 선반에서 기다리거나 지나간 뒤 이동
monsters.parry: 패링 가능하지만 성공 없이 징검다리 통과 가능
monsters.caution: 녹는 발판 위에서 정지 대기를 강요하지 않음

monsters.name: 심지 꼬마
monsters.appearance: Squat soot-dark wax worker creature with a rounded candle hood, one short unlit curled wick and broad oven-mitt hands, muted honey edges
monsters.attack: 두 손을 들어 앞쪽 지면을 한 번 두드림
monsters.response: 한 걸음 빠진 뒤 손이 바닥에 붙은 동안 공격
monsters.parry: 습득 후 손 타격 패링 시 굳은 손 부서져 긴 경직
monsters.caution: 세이브 안전 구역 밖; 화염 지속 피해 없음

monsters.name: 주걱 밀랍게
monsters.appearance: Low sideways wax crab with two unequal broad spatula claws, flattened amber shell and four short curved legs
monsters.attack: 큰 주걱을 들어 그쪽으로 한 번 쓸기, 반대 집게는 공격 안 함
monsters.parry: 습득 후 큰 집게 패링으로 옆구리 노출
monsters.caution: 전방 영구 방패 없음; 패링 없을 때도 등 뒤 접근 가능

monsters.name: 도가니 배불뚝이
monsters.appearance: Round soot-stained wax crucible creature with a wide dark open rim, short sturdy feet and two broad cream drip lobes, no flame
monsters.attack: 몸이 부풀고 양옆 짧은 거리로 밀랍 두 덩이 분출, 바닥 표시
monsters.response: 몸 가까운 중앙 또는 바깥으로 이동 후 공격
monsters.parry: 습득 후 개별 탄 반사 가능; 폭발 자체 패링 불가
monsters.caution: 선택 방용. 패링 획득 전 전투, 좁은 보상 자리에는 배치하지 않음

monsters.name: 지층 도약충
monsters.appearance: Tall folded violet-gray layered crayon grasshopper with two broad bent legs and blunt layered head, slate blue edges
monsters.attack: 목표 선반을 보고 다리를 접어 한 번 건너뛰기
monsters.response: 목표 그림자 밖으로 이동; 착지 경직 공략
monsters.parry: 패링으로 착지 경직 연장 가능하지만 회피만으로 처치 가능
monsters.caution: 공방 전 진입 가능. 패링 보유 여부로 공격 속도 바꾸지 않음

monsters.name: 덧칠 방패벌레
monsters.appearance: Wide short wax beetle carrying two overlapping blue-violet paint slabs like an open clamshell shield, visible soft orange flank
monsters.attack: 앞판을 닫고 짧게 밀친 뒤 과하게 벌어짐
monsters.response: 밀치기를 피하고 열린 옆구리 공격; 무리한 정면 연타 유도 안 함
monsters.parry: 패링 시 앞판 즉시 벌어져 1.4초 빈틈
monsters.caution: 늪 위 발판에는 배치하지 않음; 패링 필수 장갑 금지

monsters.name: 안료 사수
monsters.appearance: Stationary rounded blue-gray paint jar creature with a single horizontal rolled-paper nozzle and visible golden bead at muzzle, short wax feet
monsters.attack: 총구 안에 큰 안료 구슬이 모여 수평 단발 발사
monsters.response: 점프로 넘기거나 탄을 베고 뒤에서 공격
monsters.parry: 15→16 과녁 문은 반사 필수. 일반 전투는 반사 없이 처치
monsters.caution: 기존 포탑/잉크 사수 명칭 충돌을 이 종으로 통일 제안. 장치 작동 전 보호 표식·탄 재공급

monsters.name: 무딘 창 시종
monsters.appearance: Short rose-gray wax tower sentry with a rounded broken helmet and one broad stubby lance, small dark visor and heavy paper sash
monsters.attack: 창을 비스듬히 들고 잠깐 멈춘 뒤 수평 단발 찌르기
monsters.response: 멈춤을 보고 거리 확보; 찌르기 뒤 긴 회복 공격
monsters.parry: 단발 패링으로 창이 바닥에 박혀 1.4초 노출
monsters.caution: 보스 뒤 추가 도전으로 도입. 안전 방 19·22와 보스 방 20에 일반 몬스터 추가 안 함

monsters.name: 밀랍 방패 인형
monsters.appearance: Compact burgundy-gray wax puppet with one large rounded rectangular paper shield and tiny feet, asymmetrical open right shoulder
monsters.attack: 방패를 두드려 예고 후 짧은 밀치기; 연타 자동 반격 없음
monsters.response: 등 뒤 이동하거나 밀치기 종료 노출 때 공격
monsters.parry: 패링 시 방패가 열려 큰 빈틈; 비패링도 같은 약점 공략 가능
monsters.caution: 벽타기 중인 플레이어를 밀랍 벽에서 떼는 매복 금지

monsters.name: 봉인 리본 망령
monsters.appearance: Floating folded rose-gray wax-paper seal with a broad oval stamped head and two short heavy curled ribbon tails, no humanoid skeleton
monsters.attack: 리본을 벌리고 느린 봉인 탄 둘을 0.25초 차이로 같은 높이에 발사
monsters.response: 같은 점프로 두 탄을 넘기거나 한 발씩 베기
monsters.parry: 두 탄 반사 시 빠른 처치; 첫 반사만으로 경직해 두 번째 발사 취소
monsters.caution: 22번 세이브 내부 제외. 좁은 벽타기 통로에 탄막 금지
